# v0.8.0 — Repair imports and reduce preparation overhead

2026-09-11 (UTC) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/yyyz1011/sheetdelta/releases/tag/v0.8.0)

## Changes

Repair source cells without reparsing files, with full validation and React/Vue editing examples. Indexed header matching, cached source locations and removal of unnecessary empty-rule passes reduce preparation overhead. See the benchmark guide for measurements and limits.

## Installation and upgrade

Install this version:

```sh
npm install sheetdelta-core@0.8.0
```

Review the [migration guide](../migration) and [related usage guide](../import-repair) before upgrading. This is a summary of released changes, not a claim of support for every Excel feature.
